items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: All during this week Booker T. Washington, (inaudible), the manager, asked me could I get a group in there.

ctx.x: On crutches, yeah. And Hal and handling the (inaudible) master contract on the show and paying off and doing the collecting and whatever, until I got to the jobs where we wasn't making any money at all, but we were running up hotel bills and had to eat. I had to call the office to send me some money to bail everybody out.

Tell you what happened, they had -- [Blackmon] and somebody had a championship fight there. Joe Louis was in town, and this was spur of the moment. All during this week Booker T. Washington, (inaudible), the manager, asked me could I get a group in there. We were going to have a party after the fight in his club downstairs. (Inaudible) gal that used to play piano with me, Boo Boo Pleasant.
